news.headline: uniQure N.V. (QURE) Receives $65.00 Consensus Price Target from Brokerages
news.summary: Seventeen research firms now cover uniQure with an average 12-month price target of $65 and a consensus 'Moderate Buy' rating (13 buys, 3 holds, 1 sell), reflecting continued Wall Street optimism after the FDA's alignment on the AMT-130 accelerated approval pathway.

news.headline: uniQure (QURE) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
news.summary: Management detailed the plan to submit the AMT-130 Huntington's disease BLA under accelerated approval in Q3 2026, discussed confirmatory-study design talks with the FDA, and reiterated cash runway into 2030 following the June capital raise.

news.headline: uniQure (NASDAQ:QURE) Lowered to 'Sell' Rating by Wall Street Zen
news.summary: Wall Street Zen downgraded uniQure to Sell, a contrarian call that stood out against a wave of bullish analyst actions following the FDA's regulatory alignment on AMT-130.

news.headline: uniQure (NASDAQ:QURE) Price Target Raised to $75.00 at Wells Fargo & Company
news.summary: Wells Fargo raised its price target on uniQure to $75 following the Q2 report, citing increased confidence in the accelerated approval path for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease.

news.headline: Wolfe Research Upgrades uniQure to Outperform, Announces $65 Price Target
news.summary: Wolfe Research upgraded QURE from Peer Perform to Outperform, arguing the market underestimates the odds of AMT-130 approval and modeling a 70% probability of success with roughly $2 billion in U.S. peak sales potential.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure confirmed FDA meeting minutes support a Q3 2026 BLA filing for AMT-130 under the accelerated approval pathway, reported a $81.1 million Q2 net loss, and said the $259 million June capital raise extends its cash runway into 2030 alongside early positive data from its Fabry disease (AMT-191) and epilepsy (AMT-260) programs.

catalysts.label: US BLA submission for AMT-130 (Huntington's disease)
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Biologics License Application for AMT-130 under the FDA's accelerated approval pathway, based on FDA-confirmed alignment on using 3-year Phase I/II data.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA Marketing Authorization Application for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Following a successful pre-submission meeting, uniQure plans to file a UK MAA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease as a parallel regulatory path to the US BLA.

catalysts.label: 4-year AMT-130 data analysis
catalysts.detail: uniQure and the FDA discussed the statistical analysis plan for the 4-year Phase I/II data readout expected in Q3 2026, which will further inform the regulatory package.

catalysts.label: Confirmatory study initiation for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure has committed to starting a post-approval confirmatory study without delay once study design (including a possible standard-of-care control arm) is finalized with the FDA.

catalysts.label: Updated AMT-260 (epilepsy) Phase I/IIa data
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to report updated data, including from the higher-dose second cohort, from the GenTLE study of AMT-260 in refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next scheduled quarterly financial results and pipeline update; exact date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA accelerated approval decision for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Following BLA acceptance and standard review timelines, analysts estimate a potential approval decision in 2027, with peak US sales estimates around $2 billion cited by some analysts.

pulse: uniQure's narrative has swung sharply positive since the FDA's late-June/July alignment confirming that 3-year Phase I/II data can support an accelerated-approval BLA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, with the company now guiding to a Q3 2026 US filing alongside a parallel UK MHRA submission. A $259 million capital raise extended the cash runway into 2030, and a wave of analyst upgrades and price-target hikes (Wolfe Research, Wells Fargo, Mizuho, H.C. Wainwright) pushed the stock into the $60s-$70s, though a lone Sell call from Wall Street Zen and continued execution/confirmatory-study-design risk temper the otherwise bullish setup. Early pipeline readouts in Fabry disease (AMT-191) and epilepsy (AMT-260) add optionality beyond the core Huntington's asset heading into next year's regulatory decisions.
